subject.title: macOS permission status can trigger Automation consent

question: Should the macOS app treat passive Automation status checks as a strict no-prompt privacy boundary and implement the proposed API split now?
rationale: The report identifies a consent-boundary defect, but the exact macOS implementation and platform-contract details require owner confirmation before changing native permission behavior.

options.title: Approve the no-prompt status split
options.body: Make passive status checks non-interactive and preserve consent prompting exclusively for the user-initiated Grant action.

options.title: Define a different consent contract
options.body: Keep the issue open while the macOS owner specifies an alternative status and authorization behavior with equivalent no-surprise consent guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the no-prompt status split
recommendation.body: Make passive status checks non-interactive and preserve consent prompting exclusively for the user-initiated Grant action.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reporter and supplied the concrete native macOS diagnosis, pending feature-history confirmation.
